biotools.summary: HiTIPS is a flexible and open-source high-throughput image processing software platform designed to expand image analysis capabilities and incorporate new image processing algorithms. It provides a graphical user interface and supports automated cell and nuclei segmentation, spot signal detection, nucleus tracking, and quantification.
